long_biography.plain_text:
In the 1990s, Álvaro Muñoz Beraza travelled from Murcia to California looking for expertise in seedless-grape breeding. He found geneticist Timothy Sheehan and founded SNFL, giving his family’s produce company a foothold in proprietary fruit varieties. That research-led move shifted part of the business from growing and distributing fruit toward owning agricultural intellectual property.

Muñoz is the grandson of AMFRESH’s founder and leads its third-generation chapter. As chief executive, he broadened farming and infrastructure across markets, then brought SNFL together with acquired IFG under BLOOM FRESH. Today BLOOM FRESH breeds and licenses fruit varieties, while AMFRESH grows and supplies produce through farming operations and retailer partnerships across multiple markets.
